title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (20/20): Dr. Chen at the Community Clinic
note_en: 不仅……更…… means "not only X, but even more Y," and it ranks the second point as more important: 基层医生的工作不仅是看病开药，更重要的是帮助居民建立健康的生活习惯 "A community doctor's job isn't just seeing patients and prescribing medicine; what matters even more is helping residents build healthy habits." English "not only ... but also" treats the two points as equal, so 更 ("even more") adds a shade that English has to spell out.
